documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our partner support team struggles with manual status updates. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer explicitly states that their partner support team struggles with manual status updates and that they want workflow coordination and account reporting. They have requested a discovery meeting to understand their requirements but have not approved a budget. The account is currently in the 'qualified' stage with verified consent and ownership by 'cedar-east'.

claims.quote: Our partner support team struggles with manual status updates.
We want workflow coordination and account reporting.
Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your partner support team is currently facing challenges with manual status updates, and you are looking for workflow coordination and account reporting solutions. A discovery meeting would be a great opportunity to explore your specific requirements and how Cedar Systems can support your needs. We will schedule a session at your convenience.
questions: What specific workflows or processes are currently being managed manually by your partner support team?
Are there any existing systems or tools that you are currently using for workflow coordination or account reporting?
What are your expectations for the integration timeline and deployment process?
uncertainties: No budget has been approved for this initiative, which may impact the timeline or scope of the project.
